summary: Sanders County, MT log cupola cabin on the east summit, 18 mi NNE of Thompson Falls; built 1933 (or 1928 per Forest Lookouts), destroyed 1962; now listed as a ground site, gone.

facts.design: Log cupola cabin on the east summit
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1962 per firelookout.com; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the site as a ground site that is gone. No source describes what remains.

corrections.why: firelookout.com names only the Lolo National Forest. Forest Lookouts lists the Cabinet National Forest, then the Lolo National Forest, so the brief's single Cabinet name leaves out the Lolo name that both pages give.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1933 for the cupola cabin; Forest Lookouts gives 1928. A November 1933 Ledger item refers to the existing Two Trees Lookout, so a lookout was in place by late 1933. The story reports both dates rather than choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out on status (gone) and kind (ground). Two corrections: the agency field should carry the Lolo National Forest per firelookout.com, and the Forest Lookouts page lists Cabinet first, so both names are in the story. The build date conflicts (1928 vs 1933) and is reported as a conflict. No staffing or fire events were found in the sources read. The 1962 end date rests on firelookout.com. No source describes the summit today or its access, so the access key is omitted. Photo filenames are from the page HTML; neither image's date is given on the page, so no year is set. One WebSearch and about three page reads used.
